notes.title: 2021 update
notes.notes:
Engine Evolution gets its final major update!
Improved multiplayer, physics, graphics, performance, and much more!

Engine Evolution has almost reached its final destination! But worry not! Because Engine Evolution 2021 is here! You can download it now for free: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1589770/Engine_Evolution_2021/

notes.title: Patch 2.0 - patchnotes
notes.notes:
- New multiplayer and matchmaker
- More motorcycles (including electric motorcycle)
- Much more performance
- New graphic
- New HD motorcycle models nad textures
- Instant coloring of motorcycles
- Fixed performance peaks
- Clearer and more logical customization
- Clearer UI
- Redesigned UI of upgrades, equipment, and consumables
- Accelerated loading
- Reduced RAM usage
- Much more crowded maps
- New real tracks - Dymokury, Jičín and Most
- Bug-free localization for Czech and English
- Auto-login feature
- Daily missions
- Ratings, leaderboards

NOTE: The game sometimes crashes on startup. I am looking into it. Please try restarting the game in that case.
